name: Fast Gloss

features.text: Leaves a glossy, water-resistant coating on tires & exterior trim.
Quick-dry formula reduces runs and product “sling.”
Restores faded rubber and protects against UV damage.

description: A fast-drying, solvent based, silicone tire dressing. Fast Gloss™ leaves a gloss protection on tires and exterior trim. It is crystal-clear and has a solvent odor. This product is not recommended for interior use due to its volatile and slippery properties.
application: Using a trigger sprayer, carefully apply a fine mist to the surface or, with a damp sponge, wipe down the surface. Remove excess product from surfaces with a soft, clean cloth (if insufficient time for total drying, wiping the surface with a cloth can aid in preventing “sling”). Warning: “Sling” can stain some painted-plastic surfaces around the wheel wells.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Gloss - 8 Durability - 7
